description: Lead time for a new order. Production takes 5 to 7 working days once payment clears, subject to seasonal demand. Pass the customer's town and 4-digit street postal_code (province and suburb help) and the transit range is The Courier Guy's own quote from our Knysna depot to that town; without them it is the standard 2 to 5 working days. Returns working-day ranges and a summary safe to share. Never quote a dispatch or delivery date: weather and production set them.

order_date.description: ISO date of the order (e.g. '2026-05-18'). Defaults to today.

postal_code.description: 4-digit South African STREET postal code, e.g. 2196

width_mm.description: Optional widest blind in mm (sets the parcel length)

name: get_delivery_estimate
title: Estimate lead time and delivery
